SitePartDef.label: dormant Asuran facility
SitePartDef.description: An unusually intact, clearly Asuran facility centred on a dark pattern core, silent relays and empty reconstruction plinths. The core may wake a finite Lattice defensive cadre if approached.
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: The facility is unmistakably Asuran: pale composite walls, a dark central continuity core, silent relays and empty reconstruction plinths. Nothing is active yet.
